summary: Página de OpenAI sobre sus bots: OAI-SearchBot (búsqueda de ChatGPT), GPTBot (entrenamiento), OAI-AdsBot (anuncios) y ChatGPT-User (acciones de un usuario, sin robots.txt asegurado). Recomienda permitir OAI-SearchBot en robots.txt para aparecer en la búsqueda.

quotes.text: OpenAI uses OAI-SearchBot and GPTBot robots.txt tags to enable webmasters to manage how their sites and content work with AI.

OAI-SearchBot is used to surface websites in search results in ChatGPT’s search features. Sites that are opted out of OAI-SearchBot will not be shown in ChatGPT search answers, though can still appear as navigational links.
To help ensure your site appears in search results, we recommend allowing OAI-SearchBot in your site’s robots.txt file and allowing requests from our published IP ranges below.
Because these actions are initiated by a user, robots.txt rules may not apply. ChatGPT-User is not used to determine whether content may appear in Search.
Disallowing GPTBot indicates a site’s content should not be used in training generative AI foundation models.

note: La página no tiene encabezados en su raíz de contenido: todo el texto está en el preámbulo (#). La parte de la recomendación sobre los rangos de IP publicados no se puede comprobar desde fuera del operador, y GPTBot es de entrenamiento: ninguna da requisito.
